name: Cancel Appointment — User Cancels Existing Booking
goal: User cancels an existing appointment; bot confirms cancellation and ends flow.
constraints: Eligibility mode is 'manage'; user selects 'Cancel appointment'.

result.message: You already have an appointment booked.

phases.description: Bot presents manage options; user selects 'Cancel appointment'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot stores user intent as cancel.

phases.description: Bot confirms cancellation and ends conversation.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays cancellation confirmation and exit message.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
